title: equisetum heleocharis f. uliginosum
intro: Equisetum heleocharis f. uliginosum, commonly known as marsh horsetail, is a type of plant belonging to the Equisetaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to improve kidney function and reduce inflammation, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as kidney stones and arthritis. The therapeutic actions of marsh horsetail include diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of certain health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and silica, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
